data.name: Genvieve
data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Genoveva, derived from genos (race, stock) and iēvós (yield, give). This name means 'treasurer of the genius' or 'yielding to a noble and noble-minded one'. In medieval literature, Saint Genevieve is the patron saint of Paris and is known for her bravery and faithfulness during times of crisis.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing wisdom, courage, and devotion.
